notes.title: Animal Adventure is now available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hello, Animal Adventure fans!

We're excited to announce that the Early Access version of Animal Adventure is now live!

There's still a lot of work to be done in the Early Access version, but we want to keep you updated on the game's progress and make this a co-created experience.

We look forward to your participation and feedback! Animal Adventure is a game that grows with you.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Animal Adventure: Demo Play Appreciation & Early Access Announcement]
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Firstly, we'd like to say a huge thank you to the many of you who have played the Steam demo. 

Your interest and support means a lot to us!

We've been working hard to make the game even more polished with your feedback, and the release is just around the corner. 

The Early Access launch is on 16 March at 5pm PDT. That's just a few days away!

We can't wait to share more content and gameplay improvements with you soon.

Thanks again, and we'll see you in Early Access soon!

notes.title: Animal Adventure - Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, Animal Adventure is releasing a demo during the Steam Game Festival! (23 February - 04 March)

You'll be able to play as 3 animal characters, 5 different spirit skills, 3 team battle maps, 3 solo maps, and 2 tutorial-only adventure maps. 

We'll be running a community channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/4yRpKEJnj8]Discord server[/url], so feel free to add your ideas!

Please play the demo version. If you like what you see, please add it to your wishlist!

We hope you enjoy our game during the festival :)

notes.title: Animal Adventure Early Access Release Postponed
notes.notes:
Hello, this is GonGun Games.

First and foremost, we want to sincerely thank everyone for supporting and eagerly awaiting the release of [b]Animal Adventure[/b].

At the 2024 G-STAR event, hundreds of players had the chance to try [b]Animal Adventure[/b] firsthand, and they provided us with invaluable feedback. Taking this feedback to heart, we are working tirelessly to deliver a more polished and refined game.

As part of this effort to enhance the game’s quality and ensure a better experience for all players, we have made the decision to postpone the Early Access release of [b]Animal Adventure[/b] from December 18, 2024, to March 2025.

We deeply appreciate your ongoing interest and support and promise to bring you an even better gaming experience soon.

Thank you,
GonGun Games
